items.title: Percy Gabriel Interview, 1987-07-10
items.q: So I think we left off, you were in New York with Bobby Robinson.

ctx.x: Yeah, we're on reel number two and we're at the Howard Tilton Library and in it is the Latin American Library and we're in the seminar room. And what is the continuation of the Percy Gabriel interview? The 10th of July, 1987.
Yeah, okay. So I think we left off, you were in New York with Bobby Robinson. Yes.

They were talking about you and the pay. Yes, that's when I left and went to Florida. But some of the interesting things that I run into before that, which was, I went to work with Lee Collins. I don't know how he found out about me. Somebody told him about me when I was in New Orleans. I was working at the Moulin Rouge then.
